## History

Following his wedding, Robert Baxter took offense at a [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) choir performance as he and [Margaret](../character/margaret.md) proceeded down the aisle the next [Sabbath](../codex/places.md#sabbath), leading him to convert to a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist).
